title: StoneShapeCapability
description: Mirrors backend/jewelmind/geometry/stone/capability.py::StoneShapeCapability exactly — one entry per named Stone shape, the single source of truth for CURRENT vs PLANNED and for the real, honest distinction between geometry-generation capability and Setting compatibility (STONE-GOV-009/014; brief section 54). See docs/bible/20-stone/575-stone-capability-model.md.

status.description: All 7 target shapes are 'current' as of Sprint 18 (the strong target was achieved). Future shapes (asscher, radiant, heart, trillion, baguette, cabochon) would appear here as 'planned' if reserved architecturally — none are, per brief section 62.

generationSupported.description: Whether geometry/stone/builder.py::build_stone() actually constructs real CAD geometry for this shape.

jdlSupported.description: Whether this shape is a real, accepted StoneShape enum member.

inspectionSupported.description: Whether this shape's stone_reference component is covered by real runtime Geometry Inspection facts (generic component facts plus the STONE_REQUESTED_*/STONE_MEASURED_* dimension facts).

visionSupported.description: Whether Vision renders this shape's real generated geometry — always true for every generatable shape, since Vision parses whatever STL the backend produces generically (no shape-specific frontend code exists or is needed).

currentSettingCompatibility.description: Deliberately independent from generationSupported (STONE-GOV-009, brief section 27): a shape can generate real geometry while its current prong-setting placement remains a generic, non-shape-optimized provisional layout, honestly marked EXPERIMENTAL rather than claimed correct.

requiredDimensions.description: Which JDL stone.* fields must be set for this shape — mirrors StoneSpec's own model_validator.

symmetryClass.description: Shares geometric construction strategy across shapes (brief section 12) — never implies every shape in a class has identical construction.

referenceGeometryVersion.description: Version of the reference-geometry construction algorithm — bumped on any MAJOR change to how a shape's outline/loft is built.
